status: Exploratory geometry follow-up after visual inspection of full-context frames; fixed before this angular survey. No MHD quantities used.
anchor_origin: Previously measured B minimum at 16:00:24, held fixed for every frame and direction.
old_angle_note: The exact old angle is computed from the retained direction_xy; the approximate entry is replaced with that exact value by the script.
radiance: Calibrated FITS radiance, WCS bilinear sample, mean of all five rays before baseline division; no extra exposure normalization.
seed_rule: Strongest-prominence qualified positive peak in s=[50,350] at first epoch 15:54:24. Retain all alternatives; this is not an outer-shock label.
ranking: Descending uninterrupted qualified-link count, then median NCC on passed links; all angles and failures retained. A coherent chord is not automatically a physical normal.
selection_scope: Candidate brightness-pattern tracking, not material velocity or MHD wave identification. No model-fitting or solar deprojection.
projection_tests: Compute off-limb and finite-data support for each ray at every sampled position. Separate an inner bright structure from a more distant candidate crest in plots; neither is pre-labelled as contact or shock.
